description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the chest CT registration operation RunCTRegistration
description_zh: 本文介绍胸部CT配准RunCTRegistration的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageprocess run-ct-registration --data-format DICOM --org-name '测试组织' --org-id 7ff51bfe-e73d-11ea-827d-506b4b3f3cf6 --data-source-type HTTP_FILES --reference-list ReferenceURL=https://medclients-sh.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/demo/registration/ref/33_P18.4.1.dcm --floating-list FloatingURL=https://medclients-sh.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/demo/registration/flt/34_P18.4.1.dcm --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunCTRegistration

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source organization
parameters.name: org_name

parameters.help_en: The code of the data source organization
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the input data. Only `HTTP_FILES` is supported
parameters.help_zh: 输入数据的类型，仅支持`HTTP_FILES`
parameters.name: data_source_type

fields.help_en:
The list of reference image URLs. We recommend that you use OSS links in the China (Shanghai) region. If the files are stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
At least 8 frames and at most 600 frames
fields.help_zh:
参考图像URL地址列表。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
至少8帧，至多600帧
fields.name: reference_url

fields.help_en:
The list of image URLs to be registered. We recommend that you use OSS links in the China (Shanghai) region. If the files are stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
At least 8 frames and at most 600 frames
fields.help_zh:
待配准图像URL地址列表。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
至少8帧，至多600帧
fields.name: floating_url

Data.description_en: The returned result data. After the asynchronous task is successfully executed, call the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

DUrl.description_en:
The download URL of the registration result.

The data storage format is `DICOM` with the `.tar.gz` suffix.
The URL is valid for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, the URL expires and must be regenerated
DUrl.description_zh:
配准结果下载地址。

数据存储格式为`DICOM`, 后缀为`.tar.gz`。
有效时间为5分钟， 5分钟后链接失效，需要重新生成

NUrl.description_en:
The download URL of the registration result.

The data storage format is `NIFTI` with the `.nii.gz` suffix.
The URL is valid for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, the URL expires and must be regenerated
NUrl.description_zh:
配准结果下载地址。

数据存储格式为`NIFTI`, 后缀为`.nii.gz`。
有效时间为5分钟， 5分钟后链接失效，需要重新生成

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
